story.lead: Sita is a final-year Pulchowk CS student.
story.body: Her family is about to pay Rs 30 lakh for a Japan consultancy. Instead, an alumnus in Seattle backs her with $1,000, a client funds six months of her salary, and every delivered month lands in her bank account as NPR. She never touches crypto.

checklistItems: Compare delivery against the approved spec and evidence.
Check whether the freelancer response explains the gap or confirms the issue.
Uphold the claim only if the delivery clearly fails the agreed requirements.
Dismiss the claim if the delivery meets the approved requirements.
